appName: Extreme VR Car Drift Racing Simulator
displayName: Extreme VR Car Drift Racing Simulator
display_name: Extreme VR Car Drift Racing Simulator
display_long_description:
Get ready for the ultimate VR drifting experience!
 Step into the driver’s seat of high-powered cars and master the art of drifting in Extreme VR Car Drift Racing Simulator. Feel the adrenaline as you slide around tight corners, pull off perfect handbrake drifts, and race against the clock in stunning virtual environments.
Key Features:
🚗 Immersive VR Racing – Experience realistic car physics and fully interactive VR controls.


🔥 Extreme Drift Action – Perfect your slides, control your speed, and dominate every track.


🌆 Multiple Tracks & Environments – From city streets to mountain roads, each track offers unique challenges.


🏆 Challenging Missions & Time Trials – Push your skills to the limit and compete for high scores.


🎮 Customizable Cars – Upgrade your vehicles, tune your drift setup, and race your way.


🌟 Stunning Graphics & Sound – Enjoy realistic visuals, engine sounds, and immersive VR effects.


Whether you’re a casual player or a hardcore drift racing fan, this simulator gives you the thrill of drifting in full VR.
